text: What is system design, for data engineers — welcome to the final course in this track.

Every course so far asked how to build one thing correctly. System design asks a different question — given a problem with no prescribed tools, which pieces do you choose, and why, before writing any code at all.

Nothing here is a brand-new tool. Every building block comes from the three courses before this one — python and SQL, delta lake and structured streaming, eventstreams and KQL. This chapter is about when and why to reach for each one.
That's the actual skill a senior data engineer uses daily, and the skill a real interview actually tests. Next up: requirements gathering — the first question in any real design.
